OPTIONAL — C-SITE / COMMANDER CENTRAL (skip if site does not use cloud portal)

Not every store needs this. When the site uses C-Site (Commander Central / cloud portal), a full PSI reload often drops the cloud registration even though SMS Import/Export brings most local settings back. VRSD remote upgrades usually keep the link; plan to re-link after a manual PSI reload. This is typically the only extra post-reload step for C-Site features.
Does this site use C-Site / Commander Central?
If no, mark Done and skip 21–24. If yes, capture pre-reload cloud status and complete re-onboarding after the reload.
C-Site cloud account credentials on hand
You need the C-Site Management portal email/password — not the local Configuration Client manager password. Note which account/merchant the site sits under (do not store passwords in photos).

How to use this Pre-Reload Punch List
1. Always launch from Launch-PreReload-PunchList.bat (or .ps1). That creates a NEW working copy under Working-PunchLists\ (or a site punchlists\ folder) and leaves this MASTER untouched.
2. Fill yellow cells with values. Use dropdowns on checkbox columns: ☐ = not done, ☑ = done. Mark Photo when you have a clear photo of that screen.
3. Use the Detail sheets (Network & Payment, Loyalty & Mobile, Forecourt & Ports, Site Security & Versions) for structured field capture when notes get long.
4. Generate a fresh Config OTP right before reload (CSR Functions → Maintenance Menu → Generate Config OTP) and write it in the header.
5. After reload, walk the same list and set “Verified after reload” ☑. Add post-reload notes for anything that needed manual fix.

6. OPTIONAL teal section (C-Site / Commander Central): only for sites that use the cloud portal. Full PSI reloads often break that link; SMS restore alone usually will not re-onboard it. Skip the whole block when the store does not use C-Site.
7. Pair this punch list with a full SMS backup. Together they cover the vast majority of CITGO VAPS post-reload headaches.
